Initial release.

- First public version with all core features enabled.
- Provides schedules, teams, rosters, coaches, news, and broadcast links for Myers Park High School athletics.
- All tools are public read-only; no login or credentials required.
- Team resolution process clarified for accurate data.
- Extensive usage guidelines and caveats included to ensure accurate interpretation of school data.

- Updated documentation in SKILL.md with more detailed guidance for interpreting game scores and school year limitations.
- Added clarification that a null score means "unknown", not zero, and should not be inferred as a win/loss.
- Emphasized Myers Park’s tendency not to record scores, urging clear messaging when results are missing.
- Explained that past season data is limited and what empty results from lookups actually mean.
- Stressed that "scored" games are only those where both teams’ scores are available, not just played games.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md file.

- Initial release of Myers Park Athletic Zone skill.
- Provides schedules, rosters, coaches, news, and broadcast links for Myers Park High School athletics.
- Supports lookup and browsing of team schedules, upcoming events, team rosters, and coaches.
- News, game video links, and photo galleries can be accessed directly from the public school athletics site.
- Scores and results available, but only for the current school year; score completeness may vary.
- All features work instantly—no login or account needed.
